requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve source or true-copy context and assess whether exports retain enough provenance for their intended evidence use
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Original/true-copy context requires scans, exports, reports, screenshots and transcriptions to retain traceable source context when used as controlled evidence.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: include relevant electronic metadata audit-trail access and sequence context when risk-relevant rather than relying on the flat export alone
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Electronic context matters and the Corrections/Audit Trail stage require risk-based metadata, audit trail, role/access, time/sequence, system-version and export/migration context.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat every PDF export or screenshot as equivalent to the original electronic record without source context
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly marks unclear copies or exports and requires source/true-copy context.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: ignore relevant audit-trail or metadata evidence because the visible report looks complete
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: A flat export is not allowed to hide relevant electronic history or metadata context.
